plain.li: [take] These go my way, I'll see they get there.
[take] Letters for the road, I'll hand them on where I can.
[take] Our road passes close enough, I'll carry them.
[take] I'll keep them dry and out of sight.
[bring] I was given a letter for this place along the way.
[bring] Someone on the road asked me to bring this.
[bring] There's mail for you, I'll leave it by your gate.
[drop] Letters for the colony, as I was asked.
[drop] There, that's what I was carrying for you.
[drop] Set down safe and sound, that's my part done.
[rider] Post for the colony, and anything going out?
[rider] Mail on the road, who's got letters for me?
[rider] The post, as regular as I can make it.
[rideon] Right, on down the road.
[rideon] That's this stop done, the next one's waiting.
[rideon] Good day to you, I'll be by again.
[speak] Tell {NAME} this, word for word.
[speak] Here's what we want said, listen closely.
[speak] Say it just like this when you see them.
[heard] I'll say it just as you said it.
[heard] I have it, every word.
[heard] They'll hear it from me the way you put it.
[setout] I'll be back with their answer.
[setout] It goes in my own hands, then.
[setout] A long road, but it's ours to ride.
[home] Back, and I've brought their answer.
[home] I'm home, and they wrote back.
[home] Long road, but here's what they said.

warm.li: [speak] Give them our warmest, and tell them this.
[home] It's good to be home, and they send their best.

blunt.li: [speak] Just tell them this, plain as I say it.
[heard] Got it, no need to say it twice.
